newsitem.title: USA: Milestone files action vs Spintech chairman.
newsitem.headline: Milestone files action vs Spintech chairman.

text.p: Milestone Scientific Inc said Wednesday that it and its Spintech Inc subsidiary had begun legal action against Ronald Spinello, the chairman and director of research at Spintech.

The company said its complaint, filed in U.S. District Court for New Jersey, seeks recovery of compensatory and punitive damages of more than $4 million. A release from the company said the damages were for "extortion and tortious interference with existing and prospective contract and business relationships."
A spokesman for Milestone and the company's attorney declined to elaborate, and the company's attorney, Steve Zelnick, said Spinello is still working at Spintech.
Spinello could not be immediately reached for comment.

The company's release said the complaint also seeks a declaratory judgment denying Spinello of rights to technology developed while he directed research at Spintech relating to ancillary components of computer controlled local anesthetic delivery system.
